findings.evidence:
Information We Gather from You
Personal Information
We do not collect any personal information from a visitor to our sites unless that visitor explicitly and intentionally provides it. Under no circumstances do we collect any personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, health, or sex life.
findings.rationale: The policy explicitly states that they do not collect personal information from visitors, thus meeting the purpose limitation requirement.
findings.verifier_reason: The evidence provided in the policy does not address the collection of demographic data, which is the focus of the finding. Additionally, the cited sections (Sec. 9(3) and Sec. 17(3)) do not pertain to the issue of undisclosed collection of demographic data.
